createBookingForGuest.introConfirmed: Hi {name}, you're all set for {title}. Here are your booking details.
createBookingForGuest.introPending: Hi {name}, we've sent your request for {title} to the host. We'll email you the moment it's confirmed.

createBookingForOwner.introPending: Hi {hostName}, {guestName} requested to book {title}. Confirm or decline it from your reservations.

createAccommodation.introLive: Hi {name}, {title} is now published and guests can book it. You can edit it anytime.
createAccommodation.introReview: Hi {name}, thanks for accommodation {title}. We're reviewing it and will let you know as soon as it's live.

accommodationPublished.subject: Your accommodation is now live · {title}
accommodationPublished.heading: Your accommodation is approved
accommodationPublished.intro: Hi {name}, {title} has been reviewed and is now live. Guests can book it right away.

accommodationSuspended.subject: Your accommodation has been suspended · {title}
accommodationSuspended.heading: Your accommodation was suspended
accommodationSuspended.intro: Hi {name}, {title} has been suspended and is no longer visible to guests. If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email and we'll help.

bookingConfirmed.subject: Your booking is confirmed · {code}
bookingConfirmed.heading: Your booking is confirmed!
bookingConfirmed.intro: Hi {name}, good news — the host confirmed your booking for {title}. We can't wait to host you.

bookingCancelled.subject: Your booking was cancelled · {code}
bookingCancelled.heading: Booking cancelled
bookingCancelled.intro: Hi {name}, your booking for {title} ({code}) has been cancelled. If this wasn't expected, reply to this email and we'll help.
bookingCancelled.paymentReleased: Card hold released — you were never charged

bookingCancelledHost.introGuest: Hi {hostName}, {guestName} cancelled their stay at {title} ({code}). The nights are open again and can be booked by someone else — nothing for you to do.
bookingCancelledHost.introHost: Hi {hostName}, this confirms you cancelled {guestName}'s stay at {title} ({code}). The guest has been notified by email.
bookingCancelledHost.subjectAdmin: A booking was cancelled by support — {code}
bookingCancelledHost.introAdmin: Hi {hostName}, our support team cancelled {guestName}'s stay at {title} ({code}). The reason is below — reply to this email if anything is unclear.

bookingMissed.subject: A request expired unanswered — {code}
bookingMissed.heading: This one got away
bookingMissed.intro: Hi {hostName}, {guestName}'s request for {title} ({code}) expired before it was answered, so it was declined automatically and the guest was told the dates didn't work out. Quick replies win bookings — or turn on instant booking and never lose one to the clock.

bookingDeclined.subject: Your booking request was declined — {code}
bookingDeclined.heading: Booking request declined
bookingDeclined.intro: Hi {name}, unfortunately your request for {title} ({code}) was declined by the host. The reason they gave is below — we hope you find a great stay elsewhere.

bookingAutoDeclined.subject: Your booking request expired — {code}
bookingAutoDeclined.heading: Booking request expired
bookingAutoDeclined.intro: Hi {name}, your request for {title} ({code}) expired because it wasn't confirmed in time. No charge was made — we hope you find a great stay elsewhere.
bookingAutoDeclined.introDatesTaken: Hi {name}, the host confirmed another request for {title} covering your dates, so request {code} couldn't go ahead. Nothing was charged — plenty of other places are still free for these nights.

bookingWithdrawn.subject: A booking request was withdrawn — {code}
bookingWithdrawn.heading: Request withdrawn
bookingWithdrawn.intro: Hi {hostName}, {guestName} withdrew their request for {title} ({code}) before you responded. Nothing to do — the dates were never reserved, and your calendar is unchanged.

stayConfirmationRequest.subject: Quick check — still coming? {code}
stayConfirmationRequest.heading: Please confirm your stay
stayConfirmationRequest.intro: Hi {name}, {hostName} is getting ready for your stay at {title} ({code}) and asked us to check you're still coming. One click below confirms it — if your plans changed, you can manage the booking on the same page.

stayConfirmed.subject: Guest confirmed their stay — {code}
stayConfirmed.heading: Stay confirmed
stayConfirmed.intro: Good news, {hostName} — {guestName} confirmed they are coming to {title} ({code}). Nothing else to do.

listingFeeReminder.subject: Your listing expires soon · {title}
listingFeeReminder.heading: Time to renew your listing
listingFeeReminder.intro: Hi {name}, your listing {title} stays live for another {days} days. Renew before then and it keeps running without a break — nothing changes for guests, and bookings you already have are unaffected.

listingFeeLapsed.subject: Your listing is no longer visible · {title}
listingFeeLapsed.heading: Your listing has expired
listingFeeLapsed.intro: Hi {name}, {title} is no longer visible to guests because its listing period ended. Any stays you've already confirmed go ahead exactly as planned — only new bookings are paused. Renew and it goes straight back live, no review needed.

hostEarningsHeld.subject: You earned {amount}
hostEarningsHeld.heading: You earned {amount}
hostEarningsHeld.intro: Nice one, {name} — a guest just paid for their stay. {held} is being held for you. Add your payout details (about 3 minutes) and we'll send it your way. Nothing expires, so there's no rush.
